A.notes: Clean competent template. Audit fails: contrast (Pending 3.58:1), 324px overflow at 390 (screenshot is 714 wide), invisible focus on nav links, 11px text. Sparklines crowd delta text in KPI cards, big dead space below chart, sidebar stops at 900px, no critical stock tiers, no row actions.

B.notes: Operational-first concept: Fraunces numerals, mono labels, severity-tiered low stock with days-of-cover, action-oriented orders table (Print label, Mark packed, Retry), chart with hero number, keyboard-readable chart, filter counts. Flaws: gap under chart beside tall low-stock column, sidebar ends mid-page, large KPI numerals tightly tracked, mobile is long, 5 radii.

why: B passes every gate and turns the dashboard into a working tool with prioritised stock, per-row actions and a readable chart. A has real accessibility failures (mobile overflow, invisible focus, contrast) and a more generic, less actionable design.
